entries.title: Metacarpals 2-4 too short
entries.action: P001 diagnostic proposal lengthens M2-M4 to the radiographic means with fixed CMC ends; canonical freeze still requires carpal/CMC geometry

entries.title: Ten fingertip (distal phalanx tail) endpoints
entries.action: needs an independent DIP-centre-to-bony-tip (or DP length + DIP-to-base offset) source for all five rays; containment offsets are not evidence

entries.title: Thumb CMC: trapezium stick ends short of the first metacarpal base
evidence: joint marker method "midpoint of closest approach between participant segments"
canonical_freeze_readiness_v1 hand blocker "thumb CMC local geometry"
entries.action: rebuild with source-defined trapezium saddle and MC1 base once carpal geometry exists

entries.title: Carpal arrangement
entries.action: topology correct on both sides; exact centroids, contacts and envelopes remain BLOCKED (readiness: carpus)

entries.title: Carpal bones drawn as short control sticks / clump
evidence: INV_TARSAL_SEMANTICS analogue: control-stick length is not whole-bone length
entries.action: needs envelopes, not stick changes

entries.title: Isolated forearm/wrist/GH-rotation sweeps from the hanging posture drive the hand into the thigh
entries.action: exposed by the corrected (narrower) c003/c004 shoulders: the a003 hanging-arm posture was kept. Hand sweeps need a start posture with the hand clear of the thigh, or must be flagged; no amplitude change

entries.title: Medial clavicle close to rib 1 at rest in c003/c004

measured.location: about 12 mm lateral of the SC joint (costoclavicular region)

evidence: c003 rib pump-handle rotation and SC placement
entries.action: costoclavicular region is anatomically close; decide with clavicle/rib surface geometry before any canonical shoulder freeze

entries.title: Hip internal rotation brings the hallux onto the opposite first metatarsal
entries.action: standing start posture with feet together; needs a stance-width start posture or flagging

entries.title: c001-c003 wrist sweeps pivoted 38.4 mm off the radiocarpal joint (stale WJC)
entries.action: c004 (non-canonical) closes it

entries.title: Midcarpal follower joints separate during wrist sweeps
entries.action: two-stage wrist rotates rows about different centres; needs contact/sliding model, not a centre change

entries.title: Thumb opposition shows only palmar abduction + pronation components
evidence: tracker Phase 8 hand solver: full opposition (TMC/MCP/IP flexion) unresolved; pronation 30 deg TEST AMPLITUDE
entries.action: source-defined opposition kinematics required

entries.title: Clavicle far too long and shoulders far too broad (a003)
evidence: male CT true clavicle length ~150 mm
independent CT male endpoint mean ~155 mm, range to ~175 mm
entries.action: c003/c004 within male endpoint range (130-175) and feasible AC family (333-353 mm); still non-canonical (SC/thorax frame open)

entries.title: Scapula transverse geometry too large (a003)
evidence: landmark-compatible male 3D-CT posterolateral-acromion to medial scapular-spine midpoint = 113.0±6.6 mm, observed range 90-129 mm
entries.action: c003/c004 rebuilt from the Lee 29-landmark male scapula; exact 3D target still open

entries.title: Clavicle stays level while the arm elevates
evidence: tracker Phase 8: SC elevation (bound only) not applied
entries.action: needs a sourced clavicular elevation rhythm

entries.title: Ribs drawn as straight sticks
evidence: readiness ribs BLOCKED (proximal 2016 spiral, thoracic mapping)
entries.action: also a genuine model deficiency for rib kinematics (neck axis degenerate); needs curved rib centrelines

entries.title: Zero disc space at every disc-bearing level
entries.action: full sagittal level-stack rebuild (readiness sequence item 2); a proportional re-partition would move C7/T1 by ~40 mm and cascade into ribs/sternum, so it is not applied as a local fix. The current thoracic span agrees with the CT source (B) within 3.4% and not with the mixed-sex donor source (A, -19%)

entries.title: Sternum length
entries.action: stature/method source conflict; no direction frozen

entries.title: Radius short for stature
evidence: direct OLS regression on all 4,082 committed ANSUR II men predicts radiale–stylion 278.14 mm at 1.82 m with residual SD 10.78 mm
a003 radius osteometric proxy 247.42 mm is 30.72 mm below prediction (z −2.85; ~0.05th residual percentile)
entries.action: direction confirmed (grade B); endpoint-compatible second source required before freeze

entries.title: Humerus length
evidence: readiness humerus blockers (joint-span vs maximum-length sources inconsistent by 20-40 mm)
entries.action: known-stature male sample with matched endpoints needed

entries.title: Femoral heads appear detached from the pelvis
evidence: os coxae stick is the SI-to-pubic chord; the acetabulum is not on it
selected HJC independently corroborated by ANSUR trochanterion + radiographic offset within ~2 mm
entries.action: HJC is an independently corroborated anchor (grade A); pelvic envelope still BLOCKED (readiness pelvis)

entries.title: Knee and ankle centres
evidence: joint-centre landmarks independently corroborated; similar-stature model examples broadly compatible
entries.action: femur/tibia grade B; femur length method conflict recorded in readiness

entries.title: Patella stays put during plain knee flexion
evidence: patellar follower exists only in knee_flexion_with_patellar_follower
entries.action: apply the sourced follower in every knee-flexing test

entries.title: Hip adduction 20 deg makes the tibiae cross
evidence: amplitude is an unsourced TEST AMPLITUDE
entries.action: unchanged by instruction; needs a sourced amplitude or a contralateral-clearance start pose

entries.title: Calcaneocuboid and talonavicular joint centres float off the bones
evidence: calcaneus control stick runs posterior (subtalar facet to tuber); anterior process absent
entries.action: source-defined tarsal envelopes and contact centres; also explains the 37 mm midfoot split in subtalar sweeps

entries.title: Foot too long
evidence: a003 heel-to-toe surface ~305 mm vs stature-conditioned ANSUR ~280 mm, z +2.77
entries.action: the long foot is the r95 SURFACE; metatarsal lengths remain source-conflicted (grade C); mesh must refit to the skeleton

entries.title: Skull and face look like scattered sticks
entries.action: landmark envelopes needed (grade D placeholder geometry)

entries.title: Mandible drawn through the oral cavity
entries.action: U-shaped bone; chord is not geometry

entries.title: Left-right symmetry
entries.action: residual 0.38 mm confined to toe phalanges (inherited fit)

entries.title: c003/c004 wrist and hand lie outside the a003 body skin
entries.action: the mesh must be refitted to the skeleton (owner policy); bones are not moved to fit skin

entries.title: Unsourced movement amplitudes
entries.action: kept separate from physiological limits; no amplitude changed
